messages.content: You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
What can action items do?

Action Items is your unified task management hub that integrates ALL user-facing workflows:

✅ **Performance Reviews** - Self, manager, peer, 360° reviews auto-created when cycle launched
✅ **Leave Management** - Manager approval tasks
✅ **Document Management** - Acknowledgements & signatures
✅ **Onboarding/Offboarding** - Task tracking
✅ **Surveys** - Completion reminders
✅ **Workflow Automation** - Custom tasks

**Admin Global Dashboard** shows all pending, overdue, due today/week with department breakdown, filtering, bulk actions, and CSV export.
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
How do performance reviews work with action items?

When you launch a review cycle, the system automatically creates action items for every participant. For 50 employees with self + manager reviews, that's 100 action items created instantly.

Employees see: "Complete self-review: Q4 2024" in their dashboard
Managers see: "Complete manager review for John Smith"

Admins can track completion rates, see overdue reviews (red highlights), send bulk reminders, filter by department, and export progress reports. Due dates are set based on template configuration with automatic priority assignment.
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
What integrates with action items?

Fully integrated: Performance Reviews (all types), Onboarding, Document Management, Leave Approvals, Transactional Requests, AI Bulk Updates, Surveys, Workflow Automation.

Coming soon: Offboarding tasks, 1-2-1 meetings, Training completion, Policy acknowledgements.

All integrations automatically create action items, assign to right people, set due dates, and track completion - visible in admin dashboard!
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
How do I use the admin dashboard?

**Location:** Admin Sidebar → Action Items

**Overview cards:** Total Pending, Overdue (red), Due Today, Due This Week

**Filtering:** Search, status, type (performance/leave/docs), priority, department

**Table:** Shows title, assignee, employee, department, due date, priority. Overdue items highlighted in red.

**Actions:** Send reminders, cancel items, reassign, export CSV

**Department breakdown:** See pending by team to identify bottlenecks

Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds!
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
Show me what's overdue

Go to Admin → Action Items. Look at the red "Total Overdue" card. Click it to filter for overdue items only.

Table shows all overdue items in red with "X days overdue". You can:
- See who's responsible (Assignee)
- See their department
- Select multiple items
- Click "Send Reminders" to email all
- Export to CSV for leadership

**Pro Tip:** Filter by "Type: Performance" to see just overdue reviews, or by department to target specific teams.
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
How do I send reminders for overdue reviews?

**Quick method:**
1. Admin → Action Items
2. Filter Type: Performance
3. Click "Total Overdue" card
4. Select checkboxes for items
5. Click "Send Reminders"
6. Confirm - emails sent!

Reminder includes: List of pending items, due dates (overdue highlighted), direct link to complete.

**Pro Tip:** Send reminders 2 days before due date to prevent items becoming overdue!
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
How do I filter for specific items?

**By Status:** Pending, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled
**By Type:** PERFORMANCE_SELF_REVIEW, PERFORMANCE_MANAGER_REVIEW, LEAVE_APPROVAL, DOCUMENT_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, SURVEY_COMPLETION
**By Priority:** HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
**By Department:** Dropdown selection
**Search:** Type name or keywords

**Common filters:**
- Overdue: Click "Total Overdue" card
- Engineering pending: Filter Dept=Engineering, Status=Pending
- All reviews: Filter Type=Performance

Combine filters for precise results!
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
How do I export to CSV?

1. Go to Admin → Action Items
2. Apply filters (optional - exports filtered results)
3. Click "Export CSV" button
4. File downloads automatically

**CSV includes:** Title, assignee, employee, department, due date, status, priority, days overdue, created/completed dates, type.

**Use for:** Weekly leadership reports, department tracking, compliance docs, review progress.

**Pro Tip:** Filter "Type: Performance" + "Status: Pending" before export for clean review completion report!
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
Tell me about department breakdown

Shows pending items grouped by department (e.g., Engineering: 15, Sales: 8).

**Benefits:**
- Identify bottleneck teams
- Compare completion rates
- Target support to struggling departments
- Fair workload distribution

**Example:** Engineering has 25 pending vs Sales with 5? Click Engineering, filter overdue, contact manager, send bulk reminders, offer support.

Updates in real-time!
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
What happens when someone completes their action item?

**Employee side:** Click action item → Taken to form/page → Complete task → Submit → **Automatically marked COMPLETED** ✅

**Admin side:** Pending count decreases, appears in Completed filter, department breakdown updates, overdue count decreases (if was overdue), completion rate increases.

**Recorded:** Completion date/time, who completed, duration, audit trail.

No manual marking needed - completely automated!
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
Can I reassign action items?

**Yes!** Use when employee on leave, manager changed, wrong assignment, or workload balancing.

**Single:** View item → Reassign → Choose new assignee → Add reason → Confirm
**Bulk:** Select multiple → Reassign button → Choose assignee → Add reason → Confirm

**What happens:** Original removed, new assignee notified, appears in their dashboard, audit trail records change, due date unchanged, history preserved.
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
How do employees see their action items?

Employees see **Action Items widget** on their main dashboard.

Shows: Task title, due date, priority (color-coded: red=urgent, yellow=soon, green=normal), [View] and [Complete] buttons.

Sorted by: Due date (soonest first), overdue always on top.

Click title → Opens task directly (review form, survey, document).

**Privacy:** Employees only see THEIR items, not others' or admin views.
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
Tell me about action item priorities

**🔴 HIGH:** Compliance-critical, urgent approvals, overdue escalated, legal requirements. Daily reminders, email + in-app.

**🟡 MEDIUM (default):** Standard workflows, regular reviews, routine approvals. Reminder 2 days before, on due date, 1 day overdue.

**🟢 LOW:** Optional tasks, non-urgent, voluntary surveys. Single reminder 1 day before due.

**Auto-set:** Overdue → HIGH, due within 24h → HIGH, compliance → HIGH, standard → MEDIUM, optional → LOW.

**Pro Tip:** Don't overuse HIGH or it loses impact!
You are an expert HR AI assistant specializing in the Action Items system.
Can I cancel action items?

**Yes!** Cancel when: employee left, process cancelled, duplicate, no longer relevant, event cancelled.

**Single:** Actions menu → Cancel → Add reason → Confirm
**Bulk:** Select multiple → Cancel button → Add reason → Confirm

**Result:** Status=CANCELLED, removed from employee dashboard, not counted as pending, still visible in admin with Cancelled filter, audit trail preserved (shows who cancelled + why), cannot be uncancelled.
